item.title: Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi Win Bronze at 2025 World Rapid Chess Championship
item.description: GUWAHATI: Indian chess players Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi won bronze medals at the 2025 FIDE World Rapid Chess Championships in Doha on Monday, December 29. Humpy finished third in the women’s section with 8.5 points, tied for first after the final round but placed third due to tie-break rules. Arjun, 22, claimed bronze in the Open category, becoming only the second Indian man, after Viswanathan Anand, to win a medal at the World Rapid Championships. item.title: Khaleda Zia, Bangladesh’s First Female Prime Minister, Dies at 80
item.description: GUWAHATI: Bangladesh’s former prime minister Khaleda Zia has died aged 80 after a prolonged illness in Dhaka, her party has confirmed. The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) said she died at 6am local time on Tuesday, December 30. Reports said Khaleda had been receiving treatment since November for lung infection symptoms, and doctors said she was also suffering from advanced liver cirrhosis, arthritis, diabetes, and heart and chest problems. item.title: India Becomes World’s Fourth-Largest Economy, Surpassing Japan: Say Reports
item.description: GUWAHATI: India has become the world’s fourth-largest economy, surpassing Japan with a GDP of USD 4.18 trillion, the government has said. Real GDP grew 8.2 per cent in the second quarter of 2025-26, up from 7.8 per cent in the first quarter, keeping India as the fastest-growing major economy. The government said India is also on track to overtake Germany and become the world’s third-largest economy by around 2030, with GDP projected at USD 7.3 trillion.
